name: Viktor Lazlo
subtitle: Sideline inbound play
goal: Get an easy basket straight off a sideline inbound.
options: First: a short, quick pass to 1 at full speed. Next: 4 coming to the sideline, or 2 in the backcourt.

steps.note: 3 inbounds at half court. 1 and 2 face each other along the sideline. 5 and 4 are level with 3 on our half of the court. On "break", 2 comes to 1 and sets a screen.
1 explodes off the screen on the sideline side. First option: a short, quick pass from 3 as 1 goes by at full speed.
1 keeps going down the court on the fast break for the layup.
The big closer to the inbounder screens away: 5 screens for 4.
4 comes off the screen toward the sideline to receive the ball. 2 stays in the backcourt.
If the quick pass to 1 was not there, 3 reads it: 4 near the sideline or 2 in the backcourt.
